customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile

name.meaning: full name of the individual customer, or of the authorized administrator for a business profile, as on the profile

customer_type.meaning: whether the profile is an individual consumer or a registered business

business_name.meaning: registered business name for a business profile; empty for a consumer

phone.meaning: mobile number registered on the profile; a verification credential

email.meaning: sign-in email registered on the profile; a verification credential

date_of_birth.meaning: date of birth of the individual customer or of the business administrator; a verification credential

billing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the billing address on the profile; a verification credential

home_state.meaning: two-letter state of the billing address on the profile

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the Northgate customer profile was created

home_store_number.meaning: store number of the customer's preferred Northgate store

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the verification record, one per customer

verified.meaning: whether identity verification passed; once true it never returns to false

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

membership_id.meaning: primary id of the membership record

variant_name.meaning: the membership tier held, written as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the membership (basis defined in the membership charter lifecycle)

trial_end_date.meaning: date the free trial ends and the membership converts; empty when no trial was given

term_start_date.meaning: first day of the first paid term (or activation date of the free tier); billing periods recur from this calendar day

renewal_date.meaning: start date of the next billing period, when the next fee is due; empty for the free tier

billing_cycle.meaning: billing cycle of the tier currently held

auto_renew.meaning: whether the membership renews at the renewal date; false once a cancellation at term end is confirmed

payment_method_type.meaning: how membership fees are charged; none for the free tier

card_account_id.meaning: Northgate Card account charged for fees (foreign key -> card_holdings); empty unless payment_method_type is northgate_card

eligibility_program.meaning: eligibility program the discounted or business tier rests on; none for other tiers

eligibility_verified_date.meaning: date the verification partner last confirmed eligibility; empty for tiers needing no proof

payment_hold_date.meaning: date of the declined renewal attempt that started the current or most recent payment hold; empty if never on hold

household_member_count.meaning: number of additional household members sharing delivery benefits

business_user_count.meaning: number of employee seats in use on a Business membership

rewards_cash_balance.format: USD, 2 decimal places, may be negative
rewards_cash_balance.meaning: current Northgate Cash balance, identically the sum of earnings minus redemptions, reversals and expirations

canceled_date.meaning: date the membership closed; empty while not canceled

membership_event_id.meaning: primary id of the membership ledger row

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the membership charter

event_date.meaning: business date of the occurrence (settlement, decline, refund, benefit, earn, redemption, reversal or expiry date)

amount_usd.meaning: amount of the occurrence, always positive; the account direction comes from the event type

fee_type.meaning: which fee a charge pays; not_applicable for non-fee rows

billing_period_start.meaning: first day of the billing period a fee charge or decline is for; empty for non-fee rows

tier_at_event.meaning: tier whose fee was charged, or tier held when the row was recorded

payment_method_type.meaning: payment method charged or credited; none for non-money rows

card_account_id.meaning: Northgate Card account charged or credited (foreign key -> card_holdings); empty otherwise

attempt_number.meaning: 0 for a scheduled renewal attempt, 1 and up for retries; 0 on non-decline rows

original_event_id.meaning: membership ledger row this row refers back to: the fee charge a refund refunds, or the earning a reversal or expiry reduces; empty otherwise

refund_basis.meaning: basis of a fee refund; not_applicable for other rows

benefit_type.meaning: which membership benefit a benefit-use row records; not_applicable for other rows

order_id.meaning: Northgate order the row relates to (foreign key -> order_holdings); empty when none

source_order_event_id.meaning: order ledger row that caused the row: the order line that earned cash, or the return that reversed it; empty otherwise

basis_amount_usd.meaning: for an earning, the eligible net line amount the rate was applied to; for a reversal, the merchandise amount refunded; 0.00 otherwise

membership_request_id.meaning: primary id of the membership change request

membership_id.meaning: membership the request concerns (foreign key -> membership_holdings)

request_status.meaning: submitted when the agent records it, confirmed when the member confirms, withdrawn when the member declines to confirm

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

card_account_id.meaning: primary id of the Northgate Card account (or application)

variant_name.meaning: the card tier held, written as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the account (basis defined in the card charter lifecycle)

application_channel.meaning: channel the application was submitted through

opened_date.meaning: date the account opened; empty until approved

declined_date.meaning: date the application was declined; empty unless declined

closed_date.meaning: date the account closed or was charged off; empty while open

statement_closing_day.meaning: day of month on which statements close

card_last4.meaning: last four digits of the card number currently issued

current_balance.format: USD, 2 decimal places, negative for a credit balance
current_balance.meaning: amount currently owed, identically the sum of balance-owed deltas

disputed_balance.meaning: amount currently under dispute, identically the sum of disputed-amount deltas

security_deposit_usd.meaning: security deposit currently held; 0.00 on unsecured tiers

suspended_date.meaning: date charging privileges were suspended; empty when not suspended

suspension_reason.meaning: why charging privileges are suspended; none when not suspended

authorized_user_count.meaning: number of authorized users or employee cards on the account

card_event_id.meaning: primary id of the card ledger row

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the card charter

event_date.meaning: business date of the occurrence (transaction, posting, receipt, statement or resolution date)

amount_usd.meaning: amount of the occurrence, always positive; whether it raises or lowers the balance comes from the event type

transaction_reference.meaning: reference of a purchase, cash advance or merchant credit as shown on the statement

original_transaction_reference.format: 12 uppercase letters and digits, or empty
original_transaction_reference.meaning: the purchase a credit or dispute refers to, or the returned payment or cash advance a fee arises from

transaction_kind.meaning: kind of posted transaction; not_applicable for other rows

merchant_type.meaning: where a purchase or credit originated

merchant_name.meaning: merchant name as printed on the statement

source_record_id.meaning: the Northgate record a purchase, credit or dispute relates to (order, marketplace order, membership or protection plan reference); empty for external merchants

promo_financing.meaning: special financing chosen at checkout for a purchase

statement_date.meaning: closing date of the statement the row belongs to or refers to

new_balance_usd.meaning: new balance on a statement row; 0.00 on other rows

minimum_due_usd.meaning: minimum payment due on a statement row; 0.00 on other rows

payment_due_date.meaning: payment due date on a statement row; empty on other rows

payment_reference.meaning: confirmation number of a payment or deposit, or of the payment a return reverses

payment_channel.meaning: channel a payment was made through

return_reason.meaning: bank's reason for returning a payment

original_event_id.meaning: card ledger row this row refers back to: the fee a reversal reverses, or the dispute a credit or resolution belongs to

dispute_track.meaning: whether a dispute carries billing-error protections or is a network-only dispute

card_request_id.meaning: primary id of the card account request

card_account_id.meaning: card account the request concerns (foreign key -> card_holdings)

request_status.meaning: submitted when recorded, confirmed when the cardholder confirms, withdrawn when declined by the cardholder

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

plan_id.meaning: primary id of the Northgate Protect plan

variant_name.meaning: the plan tier held, written as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the plan (basis defined in the plan charter lifecycle)

purchase_date.meaning: date the plan was bought or Complete Monthly was enrolled

coverage_start_date.meaning: first covered day; empty until coverage starts

coverage_end_date.meaning: coverage start date plus the term in calendar months; the last covered day is the day before; empty for Complete Monthly

covered_order_id.meaning: Northgate order containing the covered item (an order reference); empty for Complete Monthly

covered_order_event_id.meaning: order line of the covered item (an order ledger reference); empty for Complete Monthly

covered_item_category.meaning: item category of the covered item; not_applicable for Complete Monthly

covered_item_price_usd.meaning: net price paid for the covered item before tax, which selects the price band and sets the limit of liability; 0.00 for Complete Monthly

bought_after_fulfilment.meaning: whether the plan was bought after the covered item had already been fulfilled (decides the waiting period)

card_account_id.meaning: Northgate Card account charged (foreign key -> card_holdings); empty otherwise

premium_paid_usd.meaning: net plan price or fees paid, identically charges minus refunds

liability_remaining_usd.meaning: remaining limit of liability, identically registered item prices minus settlements

closed_date.meaning: date the plan was fulfilled, expired, canceled or lapsed; empty while purchased or active

plan_event_id.meaning: primary id of the plan ledger row (a claim's row id is its claim reference)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the plan charter

amount_usd.meaning: amount of the occurrence, always positive; 0.00 on rows with no amount

billing_period_start.meaning: purchase date of a one-time price or first day of the month a monthly fee pays for

payment_method_type.meaning: method charged or credited; none on non-money rows

card_account_id.meaning: Northgate Card account charged or credited (foreign key -> card_holdings); empty otherwise

original_event_id.meaning: plan ledger row this row refers back to: the charge a refund refunds, or the claim a decision or settlement belongs to

covered_order_event_id.meaning: order line of the item registered, claimed on or settled

covered_item_category.meaning: item category of a registered item

incident_date.meaning: date the failure or accident happened, as reported by the plan holder; empty on non-claim rows

service_fee_usd.meaning: service fee owed on an approved claim; 0.00 otherwise

plan_request_id.meaning: primary id of the plan request

plan_id.meaning: plan the request concerns (foreign key -> plan_holdings)

request_type.meaning: what the plan holder asked for

request_status.meaning: submitted when recorded, confirmed when the plan holder confirms, withdrawn when declined by the plan holder

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

order_id.meaning: primary id of the Northgate order or register receipt

variant_name.meaning: the fulfilment program of the order, written as the official full program name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the order (basis defined in the order charter lifecycle)

order_date.meaning: date the order was placed or the register sale was made

channel.meaning: channel the order was placed through

store_number.meaning: store that sold, picked or shipped the order

order_number.format: 10 digits for online orders, 16 digits for register receipts

card_account_id.meaning: Northgate Card account charged (foreign key -> card_holdings); empty otherwise

scheduled_date.meaning: scheduled delivery date of a large-item order; empty otherwise

reschedule_count.meaning: number of times a large-item delivery has been rescheduled

ready_date.meaning: date a pickup or Drive Up order became ready; empty otherwise

fulfilled_date.meaning: date of the register sale, collection or delivery; empty until fulfilled

canceled_date.meaning: date the order was canceled; empty otherwise

returned_date.meaning: date the last unit was returned; empty otherwise

amount_paid_usd.meaning: net amount paid before tax, identically lines and fees charged minus refunds

order_event_id.meaning: primary id of the order ledger row (an order line's row id is its line reference)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the order charter

amount_usd.meaning: amount charged or refunded, never negative; direction comes from the event type

line_number.meaning: position of a line on the order; 0 on non-line rows

item_description.meaning: item name as printed on the receipt

return_class.meaning: return class that selects the return window

quantity.meaning: units bought, returned, adjusted or refunded; 0 on fee rows

unit_price_usd.meaning: selling price per unit before promotions

promo_discount_usd.meaning: item promotion discount on the line, positive or 0.00

cardholder_discount_usd.meaning: Northgate Card discount on the line, positive or 0.00

manufacturer_warranty_months.meaning: manufacturer warranty length of the item in months

substituted.meaning: whether the line is an accepted substitute

standard_fee_usd.meaning: fee before any benefit; 0.00 on non-fee rows

fee_waiver_source.meaning: source of the lowest fee on a fee row

original_event_id.meaning: order ledger row a return, adjustment or refund refers to (the line or fee)

return_number.meaning: return authorization number printed on the return receipt

restocking_fee_usd.meaning: restocking fee withheld on a return; 0.00 otherwise

receipt_type.meaning: proof of purchase presented for the return

plan_id.meaning: Northgate Protect plan covering the returned unit (foreign key -> plan_holdings); empty when none

card_account_id.meaning: Northgate Card account charged or credited (foreign key -> card_holdings); empty otherwise

adjusted_unit_price_usd.meaning: lower unit price matched; 0.00 on other rows

refund_reason.meaning: why a line or fee was refunded without a return

order_request_id.meaning: primary id of the order request

order_id.meaning: order the request concerns (foreign key -> order_holdings)

request_status.meaning: submitted when recorded, confirmed when the customer confirms, withdrawn when declined by the customer

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

market_order_id.meaning: primary id of the Northgate Marketplace order (one seller per order)

variant_name.meaning: seller program of the order, written as the official full program name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the marketplace order (basis defined in the market charter lifecycle)

max_estimated_delivery_date.meaning: last day of the delivery estimate shown at checkout

tracking_number.meaning: carrier tracking number of the shipment; empty until shipped

delivered_date.meaning: carrier-confirmed delivery date; empty until delivered

cancel_initiator.meaning: who or what caused the cancellation; none if not canceled

refunded_date.meaning: date the order became fully refunded; empty otherwise

card_account_id.meaning: Northgate Card account charged (foreign key -> card_holdings); empty otherwise

amount_paid_usd.meaning: net amount paid, identically lines and shipping charged minus seller refunds and guarantee reimbursements

market_event_id.meaning: primary id of the marketplace ledger row (a claim's row id is its claim reference)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the market charter

amount_usd.meaning: amount charged, refunded, claimed or reimbursed; never negative

line_number.meaning: line position on the order; 0 on non-line rows

quantity.meaning: units bought, requested for return or refunded

unit_price_usd.meaning: price per unit of a line

item_condition.meaning: condition the item was sold in

seller_response.meaning: seller's answer to a return request

restocking_fee_usd.meaning: restocking fee withheld by the seller; 0.00 otherwise

contact_reason.meaning: problem the buyer contacted the seller about

claim_decision.meaning: Northgate's decision on a guarantee claim

payment_method_type.meaning: tender charged or credited; none on non-money rows

card_account_id.meaning: Northgate Card account charged or credited (foreign key -> card_holdings); empty otherwise

market_request_id.meaning: primary id of the marketplace request

market_order_id.meaning: marketplace order the request concerns (foreign key -> market_holdings)

request_status.meaning: submitted when recorded, confirmed when the buyer confirms, withdrawn when declined by the buyer

trade_account_id.meaning: primary id of the Northgate Business invoice account (or application)

variant_name.meaning: terms tier held, written as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the invoice account (basis defined in the trade charter lifecycle)

organization_type.meaning: kind of organization holding the account

hold_date.meaning: date the current credit hold began; empty when not on hold

hold_reason.meaning: reason for the current credit hold

tax_exempt_status.meaning: state of the sales tax exemption certificate

exemption_certificate_date.meaning: issue date of the certificate on file; empty when none

outstanding_balance_usd.format: USD, 2 decimal places, negative for a credit balance

trade_event_id.meaning: primary id of the invoice-account ledger row

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the trade charter

event_date.meaning: business date of the occurrence (invoice date, receipt date, credit date or statement date)

amount_usd.meaning: amount of the occurrence, always positive; direction comes from the event type

invoice_number.meaning: invoice the row is or refers to

po_number.meaning: purchase order number exactly as the buyer gave it

sales_tax_usd.meaning: sales tax included in an invoice; 0.00 otherwise

payment_reference.meaning: reference of a payment, or of the payment a return or fee refers to

credit_reason.meaning: why a credit memo was issued

statement_date.meaning: statement on which a late charge was assessed

gift_card_id.meaning: primary id of the gift card record

variant_name.meaning: card type, written as the official full name

card_number_last4.meaning: last four digits of the card number
